parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to write this below the model and I got stuck finding the values of "Tt".
I used uniroot function and also fzero (usually used in Matlab) and I can get the equation resolved.
I really need help from an expert.

Thank you in advance for your help

rm(list = ls(all=TRUE))

library(rootSolve)
library(pracma)
library(phaseR)


#SoilParameters
Ks= 3600;
Beta= 0.55;
Eta= 2.7;
Theta_s= 0.41;
Theta_r= 0.06;
Psi_Water= -200;
gamma=Eta/Beta;

#crop paremeter
Tp= 8;       # FIND CORRECT TP VALUE
EC50=4.1316; # From EC_eValue_Almonds script
p= 3;              
Psi_Root=-6000; # From ANSWER App
b= 10;          # From ANSWER App
Yr0= 0;      

## Water Salinity (EC)
# The ptential range of EC values
# minimum EC value: 0.5
# Maximum EC value: 6
#Increment: 1
EC <- seq(0.5, 6, by =1)

## Irrigation (I)
# The range of Irrigation values you would like to use
# all Irrigation values are in mm/day
# minimum of range: 0.5
# maximum of range: 12
#Increment: .1
I <- seq(0.5, 12, by =.1)

## Solve Equation 12a
# Solves Equation 12a [Shani et al. 2009]
#Tt=(I-Ks*(Psi_Water/Psi_Root)^Eta); # This is the maximum guess for T
Equation_12a <- function(Tp, EC50, p, Psi_Root, b, Ks, Eta, Theta_s, Theta_r, Psi_Water, gamma, I, EC,Tt){
  #Nom_expr=(Psi_Root-(Psi_Water/((I-Tt)/Ks)^(1/Eta)))*(I-Tt)*b;
  I <- seq(0.5, 12, by =.1)
  EC <- seq(0.5, 6, by =1)
  Nom_inner_i <- ((I-Tt)/Ks)^(1/Eta)
  Nom_expr <- (abs(Psi_Root)-abs(Psi_Water)/Nom_inner_i)*(I-Tt)*b
  Nom <- min(Tp,Nom_expr)
  #Denom=1+((EC*I*(Theta_r+(Theta_s-Theta_r)*((I-T)/Ks)^(1/)))/(EC50*(I-T)*Theta_s))^p;
  Denom_inner_i <-((I-Tt)/Ks)^(1/gamma)
  Denom_inner_ii <-Theta_r+(Theta_s-Theta_r)*Denom_inner_i
  Denom_denom <- EC50*(I-Tt)*Theta_s
  Denom <- 1+((EC*I*Denom_inner_ii)/(Denom_denom))^p
  out <- (Nom/Denom)-Tt
}

max_T=(I-Ks*(Psi_Water/Psi_Root)^Eta)

  for (i in 1:length(I)){
    Ti<- c(0.01*Tp, max_T[i])}
   
  for (j in 1:length(EC)){
    for (i in 1:length(I)){
      T_1 <- fzero(Equation_12a (Tp, EC50, p, Psi_Root, b, Ks, Eta, Theta_s,
                                   Theta_r, Psi_Water, gamma, I[i], EC[j],Tt), Ti); Tt[i,j]=T_1
      }
  }
